Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidSafetyStudies

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidSafetyStudies
public final class PidSafetyStudies extends Object
Runs physics-based screening safety studies on the safeguards of a synthesized P&ID and writes the results back onto the P&ID elements.

The studies use the converged process simulation as the physical basis:

  • pressure envelope: proposed design pressure and temperature of each protected unit from its operating point;
  • relief (API 520/521): blocked outlet, external fire (wetted area, adequate drainage) and gas blow-by through a failed-open upstream liquid control valve (IEC 60534 choked gas flow); the governing case sets the relieving rate and the API orifice;
  • blowdown (API 521): vapour-withdrawal depressurization of the vessel inventory, with the smallest orifice that reaches the lower of 6.9 barg and half the design pressure within 15 minutes, the peak flare rate and the minimum fluid temperature;
  • flare load: simultaneous blowdown of all sized segments compared with the governing relief rate;
  • trip set points: placed midway between the operating value and the design or relief limit, so both margins are visible;
  • safety integrity: NOG 070 minimum SIL per function and an IEC 61511 PFDavg screening of the drawn sensor, logic solver and final elements, upgrading the architecture step by step until the target is met.

Results only replace placeholders (values containing REQUIRED or HOLD); project inputs are never overwritten. Every touched element keeps REVIEW_REQUIRED status and gets a EVIDENCE_PREFIX reference. The default PidSafetyStudies.Policy values are documented screening assumptions, not certified reliability data or approved design rules; supply project values through the policy. A HAZOP, LOPA and SRS remain required.

      public static PidSafetyStudies.Result run(PidDesignModel model, ProcessSystem process, PidSafetyStudies.Policy policy)

      Call after PidStandardConnectionProposals.complete(...) and before PidSimulationBindings.from(...).

      Parameters:
      model - P&ID proposal to update
      process - converged process the proposal was synthesized from
      policy - screening assumptions
      Returns:
      what was calculated and what is still open
